notes.title: Patch 3 - Twitch Integration
notes.content:
Do you want more people to watch you click?

Now, they can.

- Postgame includes more dialogue.
- Improved pacing flow in the back half of the game.
- Twitch integration is now activated.
- Assorted optimization and stability fixes.

notes.title: Patch 2 - Keep Clicking
notes.content:
Just a few improvements from the latest version of the game. Thank you all so much for your support of our strange experience - and look forward to further stability improvements, Twitch integration, and achievement support in the near future!

[b]NOTES:[/b]
- Return to title with saved progress is now available post-credits.
- Any previous players who made it to the void should also be able to resume from the last time they interacted with a painting.
- Internal auto-saves also now occur at 9700 and 10001 clicks, in case of any issues- they will still be cleared and deleted if the player leaves the room, but not if the game crashes or is closed.
- Objective goals and prerequisites have been adjusted.
- "Hot" and "Cold" trigger criteria broadened to include "Temperate".
- Healed painting prerequisite and goal look angle requirement made less particular.
- Tiger painting no longer viewable through restroom wall.
- Clicks passed requirements restored to proper length.
- "Stop hiding" trigger area broadened.
- Onscreen click prompt clarifies 'space' and 'tap/hold'.
- More Clickold animations + sound effects implemented.
- Clickold will not provide prompts to continue clicking post-10k.
- Initial painting turn click threshold lowered.
- More areas qualify to interact with the paintings.
- New lines for the Original Clickold.

notes.title: Major Ending Patch!
notes.content:
- Some dialogue boxes may appear clipped, but the post-credits softlock should now be addressed.

- Texture limit reduced to 2k, should increase graphical performance by ~4x
This should assist with issues regarding slowdowns and crashes during the end sequence.

- Original Clickold dialogue on sfx slider.

- Original Clickold sometimes shows blank dialogue box (on leaving during speech and then returning), but will no longer show placeholder text in it.

- Clickold will not respond to the player when not intended.

- Can no longer walk onto bed from end (bypassing state set).
